title: Line Extensions and New Service Construction — Contribution Payment and Installment Terms
content:
Each class of **Line Extensions and New Service Construction** sets the percent of the contribution that must be paid to Cedar Fork Electric Cooperative before construction is scheduled, whether the rest of the contribution may be paid in monthly installments after that scheduling payment, and the most monthly installments allowed.

## Payment terms by class

| Class of extension | Paid before construction is scheduled | Monthly installments allowed after the scheduling payment | Most monthly installments |
|---|---|---|---|
| Permanent Residential Overhead Extension | 100% of the contribution | No | 0 |
| Permanent Residential Underground Extension | 100% of the contribution | No | 0 |
| Seasonal Residence Extension | 100% of the contribution | No | 0 |
| Farm and Ranch Extension | 25% of the contribution | Yes | 12 |
| Irrigation Well Extension | 25% of the contribution | Yes | 12 |
| Three-Phase Commercial Extension | 100% of the contribution | No | 0 |
| Temporary Construction Service | 100% of the contribution | No | 0 |

## Reading the terms

- On five classes the whole contribution is paid before construction is scheduled, and no installments are offered.
- On the Farm and Ranch Extension and the Irrigation Well Extension, 25 percent is paid before scheduling and the remaining 75 percent may be spread over at most 12 monthly installments.

## Illustration (hypothetical contribution amounts)

| Class | Contribution | Paid before scheduling | Remainder | Installment terms |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Permanent Residential Underground Extension | $8,000.00 | $8,000.00 (100%) | $0.00 | None offered |
| Farm and Ranch Extension | $12,000.00 | $3,000.00 (25%) | $9,000.00 | Up to 12 monthly installments; over the full 12, $750.00 a month |
| Irrigation Well Extension | $16,000.00 | $4,000.00 (25%) | $12,000.00 | Up to 12 monthly installments; over the full 12, $1,000.00 a month |
